title: Women's Luxury Golf & Wellness Retreats in Asia
description: Discover the ultimate women's golf holiday in Southeast Asia. Combining daily golf coaching, championship courses, yoga, luxury spa days, and wine tasting.
content:
Executive Summary:

  • Holistic Championship Design for Women’s Groups: Moving beyond rigid 36-hole male group templates, Asia Golf Specialists curates bespoke Women’s Luxury Golf & Wellness Retreats across Vietnam, Thailand, and Cambodia that balance forward-tee playability with world-class spa sanctuaries, culinary masterclasses, and private boutique shopping.
  • Signature Sanctuaries & Courses: Pair scenic morning rounds at Hoiana Shores, Laguna Golf Lăng Cô, and Pineapple Valley Hua Hin with stays at TIA Wellness Resort Da Nang, Four Seasons The Nam Hai, and Chiva-Som Hua Hin.

At Asia Golf Specialists (AGS), we know that modern female golf groups are looking for an experience that is far more holistic. You want to improve your game, play spectacular courses, and enjoy healthy competition—but you also want to relax, rejuvenate, and indulge in world-class hospitality.

That is why we have engineered the Women’s Luxury Golf & Wellness Retreat across Vietnam and Thailand. It is an itinerary designed to balance the physical challenge of golf with the ultimate restorative escape.

A Day in the Life: Golf, Wellness, and Wine

We don’t just book tee times; we curate experiences. Here is what a typical day looks like on an AGS women's retreat.

Premium after-golf craft cocktails at United Bar Da Nang for women's groups

1. Sunrise Yoga & Mindfulness

Before you even touch a golf club, the day begins with a private yoga instructor guiding your group through a sunrise session on the beach, or on the private lawn of your beachfront villa. It is the perfect way to stretch, center your mind, and prepare your body for the fairways.

Morning beach yoga and mindfulness for female golf groups in Vietnam

2. Expert Coaching & Championship Golf

Whether you are a group of single-digit handicappers or enthusiastic beginners, we integrate daily coaching sessions with local PGA professionals at the practice facilities before your round.

Following your tune-up, you will tee off on Asia's most breathtaking courses—like the oceanside links of Hoiana Shores or the impeccably manicured Siam Country Club. You will be accompanied by highly trained, professional caddies who provide umbrella shade, read your putts, and ensure your round is entirely stress-free.

3. Holistic Beauty & Wellness

After 18 holes, the focus shifts to recovery and indulgence. Transition directly from the clubhouse to a private, holistic spa sanctuary. Enjoy deep-tissue massages to soothe your shoulders, restorative facials, or simply relax in your private villa’s pool.

4. Wine, Cheese, & Exceptional Dining

The evenings are dedicated to culinary exploration. Forget generic hotel buffets. Your dedicated AGS expat host will arrange private wine and cheese tasting sessions in your villa's garden, followed by reservations at the region's most exclusive dining venues—such as overlooking the illuminated rice paddies of Central Vietnam.

Luxury women's wellness and spa retreat in Hoi An, Vietnam

The Private Villa Advantage

The cornerstone of our women's retreats is the accommodation. Rather than separating your group into individual hotel rooms, we place you in a private, luxury beachfront estate.

Share a massive private pool, enjoy breakfasts prepared by a personal chef, and revel in the ultimate privacy. It provides the perfect, intimate space for your group to connect, laugh, and celebrate together after a day on the course.
